strategy.summary: Plunge the top #1 lane because the spinner cannot spot it, repeat the center spinner while Spin-N-Spot is lit, then collect numbers 1 through 11 once for 55,000 total first-collect value.

steps.text: If #1 is not collected, plunge the top-center #1 lane. Otherwise, plunge any missing top-lane number.
When top play naturally offers #4 or #5, collect it to light its upper bumper. Do not force a direct bumper hit.
Read the Spin-N-Spot lamp before shooting the center spinner.
Shoot the spinner slightly off center.
modeNotes: Spin-N-Spot: Each spin advances the yellow ship-wheel light. When the spinner stops, the selected number is spotted only if Spin-N-Spot is lit.

steps.text: Repeat spinner shots to collect missing numbers 2 through 11.
modeNotes: Number value: A new number scores 5,000. A repeated number scores 500.

steps.text: Aim the spinner line beside the red upper bumper so the ball can continue into lane 10 or 11.
Complete all 11 numbers.
Number progress remains complete on later balls. Do not try to rebuild the finished sequence.
After completion, continue safe spinner and bumper scoring. Do not chase Special for points.
modeNotes: Special: Spinner movement alternates it between lanes 10 and 11. On Buccaneer it awards a replay only and has no tournament point conversion.

fallback.title: Plunge and survival scoring
fallback.when: Use this plan when Spin-N-Spot is rarely lit or the spinner rebound is unsafe.

steps.text: Use each plunge for a missing top-lane number. Prioritize #1.
Let uncontrolled side feeds reach the lower flippers before shooting again.
After all 11 numbers are complete, use the lit top-center bumper for 1,000 per hit.
Use the top-center #1 lane for 5,000 when a safe return to the top is available.
Extend the ball. A repeated number is only 500 and Buccaneer has no end-of-ball bonus.

alternatives.title: Opposite-sling spinner bank
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the direct spinner lane is blocked by the red bumper or rejects the ball.

steps.text: From a controlled flipper, aim at the opposite slingshot face.
Bank the ball through the center spinner.
Use the move only after the angle is proven on this copy.
Stop when the bank sends the ball toward either center rubber.
Plunge #1 because Spin-N-Spot cannot award it.
Use Spin-N-Spot for the remaining missing numbers.
Collect each new number for 5,000.
Complete all 11 for 55,000 total first-collect value.
Protect the ball. Repeats are worth 500, plus spinner and bumper points.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm this is the replay-version Buccaneer. Ship Ahoy and High Seas are add-a-ball relatives with different Wow, reset, tilt, and scoring rules.
Check the Spin-N-Spot setting. It can be lit constantly, about half the time, or about one-third of the time.
A tilt ends the entire Buccaneer game, not only the current ball. Test the tilt only before competition play begins.

techniques.name: Spinner bank off the opposite sling
techniques.instruction: Aim at the opposite slingshot to redirect the ball through the center spinner. Test the bank before depending on it.

techniques.name: Off-center spinner line
techniques.instruction: Hit the spinner slightly beside the red upper bumper so the ball can continue toward lane 10 or 11.

techniques.name: #1 plunge
techniques.instruction: Use the plunge to collect the top-center #1 lane. Spin-N-Spot cannot award #1.

cautions.issue: A missed spinner can hit either angled rubber and return out of control.
cautions.response: Use a proven direct or bank line. Keep both flippers ready.

cautions.issue: A square spinner shot can hit the red bumper and return through the center.
cautions.response: Aim slightly to one side so the ball can continue toward lane 10 or 11.

cautions.issue: Lane 10 or 11 can feed a slingshot at speed.
cautions.response: Watch the full exit before another spinner attempt.

cautions.issue: Side-bumper exits can create an immediate outlane feed.
cautions.response: Keep both lower flippers ready. Do not depend on a late save.

cautions.issue: A tilt ends the entire Buccaneer game.

strategy.simpleOverview: Buccaneer uses Spin-N-Spot to collect numbered lamps 2 through 11, but the spinner cannot spot number 1. Plunge the top number 1 lane first, then repeat the center spinner while Spin-N-Spot is lit until all 11 numbers are complete.
strategy.overview: Buccaneer stores each collected number for the rest of the game. Plunge number 1 because the spinner cannot spot it, then read the Spin-N-Spot lamp and repeat the center spinner for missing numbers 2 through 11. After the sequence is complete, continue safe spinner and bumper scoring instead of trying to rebuild it.
